ai_summary: Amir Chand Jagdish Kumar (Exports) Limited reported strong financial growth in FY2025-26, with significant increases in revenue and profit, alongside improved EBITDA margins. A material impact is the successful April 2026 IPO, which raised ₹440.00 crore and drastically strengthened the balance sheet by reducing the debt-to-equity ratio from 2.07x to 0.82x, primarily for working capital. The company is strategically pivoting from an export-led rice business to a diversified domestic FMCG platform, aiming for broader product portfolio and distribution, which helps mitigate inherent agricultural and market competition risks for future growth.
